centre.title: Notifications
centre.empty: Nothing here yet. Renewals, approvals, price changes and security alerts will show up in this list.
centre.error: We couldn't load your notifications. Please refresh.

RENEWAL_REMINDER.label: Renewal reminders
RENEWAL_REMINDER.help: Sent before a subscription renews, on the lead days configured for that subscription (or your personal default).

TRIAL_ENDING.label: Trial endings
TRIAL_ENDING.help: A heads-up before a trial converts into a paid plan.

NOTICE_PERIOD.label: Cancellation deadlines
NOTICE_PERIOD.help: Reminds you before the notice-period cut-off so a cancellation still counts.

APPROVER_RENEWAL.label: Renewals you approved
APPROVER_RENEWAL.help: A copy of renewal reminders for subscriptions you approved, when the organisation enables it.

APPROVAL_REQUESTED.label: New approval requests
APPROVAL_REQUESTED.help: When a request lands in your approval queue.

APPROVAL_DECIDED.label: Decisions on my requests
APPROVAL_DECIDED.help: When one of your requests is approved or rejected.

APPROVAL_INFO_REQUESTED.label: Information requested
APPROVAL_INFO_REQUESTED.help: When an approver asks you for more detail.

APPROVAL_ESCALATED.label: Escalations
APPROVAL_ESCALATED.help: When a request waits too long and is escalated to you.

PRICE_CHANGE.label: Price changes
PRICE_CHANGE.help: A detected charge differs from the recorded subscription amount.

COST_ANOMALY.label: Cost anomalies
COST_ANOMALY.help: Month-over-month spend on an app rose above the organisation threshold.

RECEIPT_SUGGESTION.label: Receipt matches
RECEIPT_SUGGESTION.help: A receipt in a connected mailbox looks like a subscription charge.

OFFBOARDING.label: Unrevoked access
OFFBOARDING.help: A terminated member still has access to apps.

SHADOW_IT.label: Unapproved apps
SHADOW_IT.help: An app was detected that is not in your approved catalogue.

PENDING_REVIEW.label: Apps awaiting review
PENDING_REVIEW.help: Discovered apps that need a decision.

DIGEST.label: Weekly digest
DIGEST.help: A weekly summary email of approvals, renewals and spend.

grid.title: What to notify me about
grid.description: Choose a channel for each event. Channels are limited to those your organisation has enabled.

digest.title: Weekly digest
digest.description: One email a week with pending approvals, upcoming renewals, price changes and trial endings.
digest.unavailable: Email is not enabled for your organisation.
digest.help: The digest is scheduled by your organisation; you can opt out here.

leadDays.title: My default reminder lead times
leadDays.description: Used for your subscriptions when none is set on the subscription itself. Organisation default: {defaults} days.
leadDays.help: Pick how many days before a renewal you want to be reminded. Options are set by your organisation.

orgDefaults.title: Organisation defaults
orgDefaults.description: Applies to every member. Members can still switch individual channels off.

digest.title: Weekly digest schedule
digest.help: When the digest email goes out, in the organisation time zone.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.help: Email and push are held and released when quiet hours end. In-app notifications are always delivered.
quiet.hint: Leave both empty to disable quiet hours.

cost.title: Cost anomaly alerts
cost.help: Alerts admins when an app's monthly card spend rises above the threshold compared with the previous month.

scans.title: Security scans & approvers
scans.help: Toggle the daily scans that alert admins, and whether approvers are copied on renewals of subscriptions they approved.
scans.offboarding: Alert on unrevoked access of terminated members
